name: Brunhilde
source:
She is a squid-shaped cosmic wraith. She self proclaims to be the strongest. She is full of energy and is very naive. To put it simply, she's an idiot. Regarding sexual intercourse, she acts like know it all.

Her squid-like tentacles are made entirely of muscles and well-developed nerves. A single tentacle has 10 times the strength of a human male, this makes it impossible for a human to resist. The wriggling tentacles are sticky, and the suckers will make anyone moan in pleasure as they are stimulated.

Once she engages in sexual intercourse, it is possible to for her mate to take control as her mind is occupied on stimulating male genitalia and mating.  Although she is often forceful and reckless, she is a friendly alien. She will become sweet with her lover and be a companion you will get along with great.
